snippet.title: Motoracing (Windows game 2009)
snippet.description:
Motoracing is a 3D motorcycle (motorbike) racing game made by EA Group Presents, published by GameTop.com.
The main character bike driver can use a kick to other drivers to attack them as Road Rash game.
The game graphics is very good, but it's so hard.
Because he is vulnerable to a collision with a obstacle.
